reason: Class Q prior approval (Fishpool Farm, Delamere, Cheshire West and Chester): dismissed as not shown to be permitted development, because without elevations or sections the works were not shown to be reasonably necessary or within Q.1(h) and (i) (DL ¶17-20); condition 3 of the building's permission held not to exclude Class Q under Article 3(4) (DL ¶13); revised Framework noted as making no substantive change (DL ¶3) and not applied; no Framework-based reasoning

s78 appeal against conditions on a barn-to-dwelling permission (Priory Field Barn, Storrington, Horsham): allowed in part (contamination conditions 3 and 8 deleted, 5 and 16 reworded; drainage, parking, cycle, ecology, permitted-development and water-efficiency conditions kept); decided on necessity and reasonableness, local plan policies and the PPG; no switch paragraph and no Framework policy applied, the only reference being a passing remark that water efficiency is reinforced in the recently updated Framework (DL ¶23); no Framework-based reasoning
